native_contract.centroid8: Separately projected 3D centroid, excluded from original native8 corner permutations and crop-side span.
native_contract.source_verified_rule: Among only four vertical faces, choose max outward normal dot normalized(camera-cuboidcenter). Top/bottom uses physical UP. Front TOP imageX small=0/large=1, vertical pairs bottom3/2. Rear4..7 continue front correspondence across depth edges; never independently rear-X sort.
native_contract.permutation_direction: perm[dynamic_native_slot]=fixed_canonical_corner. dynamic[k]=fixed[perm[k]]. Stored dynamic arrays must not be permuted again.
native_contract.historical_area_V4: Historical projected-area rule is sensitivity only and disagrees with empirically reconstructed actual source rule; never choose the convention fitting predicted q best.
native_contract.tie_policy: Historical writer tie policy not certified. Record normal-face runner-up margin and front-top image-X separation; ambiguous cases remain UNKNOWN, not auto-resolved by GT-nearest.
native_contract.original_initializer: Same frozen first argmax candidate; raw first8 channels remain native0..7, raw9/centroid preserved separately. Original continuous/nearest/crop support availability distinct and not semantic D/E.

MR_object1.name: wooden Euro pallet
MR_object1.scope: X/Y/Z are object-model axes. X span800 and Y span1200 are fixed model lengths, not invariant camera-dynamic width/depth.
MR_object1.unit_status: Parent intake declares mm; field names match BOP model/pose conventions. Local minimal README only states license, so independent model/pose/depth scale and projection check remains required.
MR_object1.physical_UP_sign: UNKNOWN before mesh/deck/underside and supplied-pose consistency review; centered AABB alone cannot distinguish +Z top from -Z top.
MR_object1.conditional_corners_are: Candidate AABB virtual references conditional on +Z physical-UP certification; not actual mesh vertices or semantic labels.

GT_reference_vs_actual_query.GT_only: After source axis/unit/instance certification, supplied R_m2c/t_m2c and K can project declared model references; camera in object coordinates is -R.T@t. Apply only the fixed normal-facing contract, without pose fitting.
GT_reference_vs_actual_query.no_prediction_matching: Canonical-to-dynamic GT permutation is defined from supplied geometry/camera; predicted q must not select it or be reassigned by nearest GT.
GT_reference_vs_actual_query.initializer_mapping_status: NOT_RUN/UNKNOWN on MR. The expected meaning of channel k is known from the existing trained contract, but actual MR channel/reference/entity agreement requires separate fixed-R0 and visual source audit under a later authorization.

semantic_evidence.reference_vs_part_vs_surface: Record virtual reference, expected structural support/part, and actual mesh surface membership separately. Non-surface virtual corners can have a reviewable visible expected part; do not force all into U solely for lacking an exact vertex.
semantic_evidence.fullmask0: Can mean a hole, outside actual mesh/support, virtual AABB corner, reference outside frame, bad projection or missing evidence. It is not automatically external E.
semantic_evidence.fullmask1_visiblemask0: Per-instance surface visibility proxy only; cannot automatically establish native E. Pose/depth error, self boundary, uncertain structural support and source tolerance must be audited.
semantic_evidence.visiblemask1: Some visible target surface at that ray does not prove a back/virtual native reference itself is visible.
semantic_evidence.self_occlusion: Convex-facing or mesh self-depth proxy remains separate from human semantic S. S/unknown must stay outside external D/E training; other-target ownership cannot be relabeled self.
semantic_evidence.ownership: Use (split,scene,frame,scene_gt_list_index,obj_id) and matching IMID_GTID masks. Multiple obj1 pallets must never be merged by class; another obj1 pallet is foreign relative to the selected target.
semantic_evidence.depth: depth_scale, zero/invalid returns, occlusion tolerance, RGB-depth registration and provided transform alignment remain separate evidence flags; no mask/depth threshold auto-gold.
semantic_evidence.semantic_status: All MR native D/E/S labels remain UNREVIEWED/UNKNOWN at metadata stage; assistant proposals later are not human gold.

minimum_tiny_audit: Bind pinned commit and original RGB/depth/all obj1 instance mask bytes; verify GT-list-index to mask filename correspondence and preserve all instances.
Compare actual mesh bounds/units with models_info; identify deck/underside and physical-UP sign from source geometry plus multiple supplied views.
Validate K/R/t shapes, finite values, rotation orthogonality/determinant, positive camera depths and image geometry; overlay using supplied transforms only, with no fitted repair.
Compute conditional normal-facing permutation from certified axes; preserve face/tie/LR margins and every8 reference or UNKNOWN reason.

Check each reference/expected structural part on whole RGB and isolated instance masks; separate hole/virtual support, self boundary, foreign occluder, off-frame, uncertain projection and wrong entity.
Keep semantic D/E/S/U, evidence quality and future original-query availability/crop coverage separate. Do not use q error, nearest matching or predicted scores as label teachers.
Any future source split must be fixed by scene; tiny public official-val development intake is not an official blind benchmark or fitting authorization.

JPEG_future_transport_guard.raw_sample_format: Original MR RGB includes JPEG, e.g. val/000005/rgb/000015.jpg.

JPEG_future_transport_guard.required: Before any later R0/features, explicitly compare original decoder/channel order/FP precision on source JPEG and seal one canonical decoded RGB transport with byte hashes. Do not inherit V146 PNG PIL/cv2 parity or the repaired V144 JPEG assumptions.
